name: stardewvalleybuddy
description: AI companion in Stardew Valley via MCP — Claude 等 AI 助手通过 MCP 直接操控游戏中的伙伴角色

scripts.smoke: node -e "const{spawn}=require('child_process');const p=spawn(process.execPath,['packages/mcp-server/build/index.js']);let buf='';p.stdout.on('data',d=>{buf+=d;for(const l of buf.split('\n')){if(!l.trim())continue;let m;try{m=JSON.parse(l)}catch{continue}if(m.id===2){const n=m.result&&m.result.tools?m.result.tools.length:0;console.log('smoke: tools/list = '+n);if(n!==31)console.error('smoke FAILED: expected 31 tools, got '+n);p.kill();process.exit(n===31?0:1)}}});p.stderr.on('data',d=>process.stderr.write(d));p.on('error',e=>{console.error('smoke FAILED: cannot spawn server: '+e.message);process.exit(1)});const s=o=>p.stdin.write(JSON.stringify(o)+'\n');s({jsonrpc:'2.0',id:1,method:'initialize',params:{protocolVersion:'2024-11-05',capabilities:{},clientInfo:{name:'smoke',version:'0.0.0'}}});s({jsonrpc:'2.0',method:'notifications/initialized'});s({jsonrpc:'2.0',id:2,method:'tools/list'});setTimeout(()=>{console.error('smoke FAILED: timeout waiting for tools/list (is packages/mcp-server built?)');p.kill();process.exit(1)},10000);"
